# hcloudplus_projects (Data Source)

All projects the authenticated user has access to. Reads GET /_projects, walking every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hcloudplus_projects" "all" {}

output "all_projects" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_projects.all.projects
}

output "first_project_name" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_projects.all.projects[0].name
}
```
